description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] At the Lightning Burger, the Konoha genin discuss their plans for upcoming days off. While most are excited, Shikadai isn't looking forward to visiting his mother's family in the Land of Wind. Likewise, Boruto isn't excited to go camping with his excessively doting grandfather.
